rap.name: Cheuk Chi Ng (2025.10-now)
rap.bio: I got my PhD in Chemistry in the University of New South Wales under Prof Justin Gooding in 2011. My research interests lie in the intersection of mass spectrometry, proteomics and information technology, in projects such as peptide drug discovery and data storage in peptides and proteins. My hobbies are hiking and running and combination of both.

postdocs.name: Xuewei Lin (2019.08—now)
postdocs.bio: LIN Xuewei obtained a Bachelor of Engineering degree from Zhejiang University and a Doctor of Philosophy from The Hong Kong Polytechnic University. Her research interests lie in the development of mass spectrometry-based approaches for applications in food safety, chiral recognition, and metal affinity.

postdocs.name: Chengyi Xie (2025.11—now)
postdocs.bio:
I'm graduated from Hong Kong Baptist University.
My current research interest is high resolution mass spectrometry imaging.

phd.name: Yin Zhou         (2020.09—now)
phd.bio: Yin Zhou obtained his BA degree in 2020 with a major in ecology and evolutionary biology and minor in computer science from the University of Colorado Boulder. He is now a PhD student in the Hong Kong Polytechnic University and focus on the topic of data storage using biomolecules.

phd.name: Xiuer Luo (2022.09—now)
phd.bio: I am a PhD student at the Hong Kong Polythechnic University.  I obtained my Bachelor's  degree in Food Quality and Safety from Nanchang University and Master's degree in Food Science and Engineering from South China University of Tchnology. My PhD research focuses on nanopore protein sequencing and nanopore proteomics. Outside of research, I enjoy staying active through badminton, climbing, and hiking, while also relaxing with movies and spending time with animals.

phd.name: Elena Bolonova (2022.09—now)
phd.bio: Research interests: HDX-MS, Protein Conformational Dynamics, Protein Thermodynamics   Education:  The Saint Petersburg State University (Bachelor in Applied Mathematics and Physics), The Moscow State University (Masters in Biology)   Hobbies: Badminton, Hiking

phd.name: Jessie Wing Yin Wu (2022.09—now)
phd.bio: I graduated with a degree in Applied Biology and Biotechnology from The Hong Kong Polytechnic University. My research interests lie in the macrophage biology and innate immunity, particularly how macrophage-intrinsic proteins regulate receptors-mediated recognition and phagocytosis of different targets, from bacterial pathogens to cancer cells. Outside the lab, I enjoy relaxing at home and taking things slow.

phd.name: Devin Siu Leung Chau (2023.09—now)
phd.bio: I am a PhD student with an interdisciplinary background in Traditional Chinese Medicine and analytical chemistry. My current research focuses on the mechanisms of drug resistance in protein kinase-related diseases; utilizing hydrogen-deuterium exchange mass spectrometry (HDX-MS) and native mass spectrometry (native MS). I aim to elucidate the dynamic structural changes and conformational transitions in proteins that drive therapeutic resistance.

phd.name: Zezhong Feng (2023.09—now)
phd.bio: My research mainly focus on the screening, identification (by HRMS) and test of the peptide/small molecule drugs against several pathogenic proteins.

phd.name: Chang Zhao (2023.09—now)
phd.bio: My research focus on investigating protein confomational dynamics with mass spectrometry and molecular dynamics simulation.

phd.name: Jiayu Lin (2024.01—now)
phd.bio:
My research focused on chemical biology and chemoproteomics, particularly the development of NAD-based photoaffinity and fluorescent probes to study NAD-associated proteins and pathways. I use mass spectrometry for molecular characterization, quantitative proteomics, and protein modification analysis. 
B. Sc. in Guang Dong University of Technology; M. Sc. in Jinan University

phd.name: Haimei Shi (2024.01—now)
phd.bio:
Joint Ph.D. Student (PolyU/SIAT) | M.S. in Chemical Biology (Fudan University)
Focus: Phage functional protein mining and novel antimicrobial development.
Ocean enthusiast & handcraft lover.

phd.name: Feifan Shi (2024.05—now)
phd.bio: Feifan Shi is currently a PhD student in the Department of Life Sciences within the School of Science at The Hong Kong Polytechnic University. She obtained her bachelor's degree from Shenyang Pharmaceutical University in 2021 and then earned her master's degree from The University of Manchester, where she majored in clinical biochemistry. Her research interests focus on peptide drug discovery.

phd.name: Yiwei Zeng (2025.09—now）
phd.bio: My research interst focus on protein functional study, chemical biology, and de novo protein design. I enjoying exploring ways of combining chemistry, biology, and computation to solve challenging problems.

visiting.name: Chao Wang
visiting.from: I am Wang Chao, an exchange student from Guangdong University of Technology. My research focuses on the development of single-cell metabolomics methods and the construction of data processing pipelines. I mainly conduct my research using mass spectrometry. In my spare time, I enjoy sports such as basketball and swimming.

ra.name: Hin Tung Chan (2026.10-now)
ra.bio: Hello, I'm Kelly Chan. I completed my BSc in Analytical Sciences for Testing and Certification at PolyU. I am interested in analytical chemistry, mass spectrometry, and chiral recognition, and I have just joined Prof. Yao's group as a Research Assistant. Outside the lab, I enjoy listening to music and jogging. I look forward to learning from the team and contributing to the group's research.

alumni.name: Dr. Patrick Tse Fung Wong
alumni.status: Scientific Officer, The Hong Kong Polytechnic University
